blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Cloud Controller version.
An update was released for Private Cloud Controller that includes bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.

blocks.item: An update was released for Private Cloud Controller that includes bug fixes, optimizations, and version enhancements.

Support is available for editing local network settings for Private Cloud Controllers at the group level. This includes control of routes, DNS, SSH service, and more. To learn more, see Network Settings Configuration for Private Service Edges, Private Cloud Controllers, and Network Connectors.

Support is available for machine tunnels and machine groups for hosts that require authentication to specific services before logging in to Zscaler Client Connector. To learn more, see Understanding Business Continuity or About Machine Groups.

blocks.item: An update ensures that a Private Cloud Controller disconnected from the Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE) for extended periods of time can seamlessly reconnect to the ZTE even if the Private Cloud Controller had outdated or stale data.
A fix ensures that Private Cloud Controllers can remain stable while downloading large data from the ZTE.
